title: Add identity and terminal-status controls for background test-observation completion
outcome: Background test-observation completion has discriminating coverage for stale runtimes, unrelated or ambiguous keys, original-turn attribution and non-completed terminal statuses, while preserving genuinely live runs and exact evidence.
acceptance: Tests exercise replaced-runtime or stale terminal notices, unrelated/non-test or ambiguous keys, original-turn or Unattributed origins, and failed/killed completion without altering unrelated observations or inventing artifact/verification associations.
The additional controls use production frame/settlement paths and preserve the existing genuine-live and no-guessed-artifact assertions; focused checks pass on their exact input.
